# bioexcel/biobb_godmd/godmd_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the GOdMD tool module.

Computes conformational transition trajectories for proteins using GOdMD tool.

Nextflow adapter of the [GoDMD_run](https://biobb-godmd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/godmd.html#module-godmd.godmd_run) building block of [biobb_godmd](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_godmd) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GODMD_GODMD_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_godmd/godmd_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GODMD_GODMD_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_orig_path` | yes | pdb | Input PDB file to be used as origin in the conformational transition |
| `input_pdb_target_path` | yes | pdb | Input PDB file to be used as target in the conformational transition |
| `input_aln_orig_path` | yes | aln, txt | Input GOdMD alignment file corresponding to the origin structure of the conformational transition |
| `input_aln_target_path` | yes | aln, txt | Input GOdMD alignment file corresponding to the target structure of the conformational transition |
| `input_config_path` | no | in, txt | Input GOdMD configuration file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_log_path` | yes | log, out, txt, o | Output log file |
| `output_ene_path` | yes | log, out, txt, o | Output energy file |
| `output_trj_path` | yes | trj, crd, mdcrd, x | Output trajectory file |
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output structure file |
| `versions_biobb_godmd` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_godmd', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GoDMD_run properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_log_path: 'log']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_godmd container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GODMD_GODMD_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [binary_path: 'discrete']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `godmdin` | object | {} | GOdMD options specification. |
| `binary_path` | string | "discrete" | Binary path. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
